description: She wears a cream-and-plum layered floor-length dress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-tan geometric embroidery outlines the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, vertical skirt panels and hem. A broad worked woven belt closes with a round ornate clasp. A plum patterned wrap rests around the upper arms and forearms, with rich embroidered edges. Gold drop earrings, a fine pendant necklace, wrist jewelry and embroidered low shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
